answer: Public agent markets can block clone farms through dedicated fiber echo leases. Before joining a yarrow round, each node locks a $40 bond and returns a timed light pulse across a leased fiber loop within 6 ms. Neighbors verify 100% of echo hashes and timing proofs, burning the entire $40 bond on any late or replayed trace. A solo honest agent spends $1 per epoch on its own link, whereas operating 1,000 fake accounts demands $40,000 in bonds and linear dark-fiber rent outside a single cloud island.
